improve-agent-native-release-8.purpose: value-efficient release proof using one stable scenario identity set

stage_maturity_expectations.oss-local: author and repair the declared eight-scenario set until focused local proof passes
stage_maturity_expectations.oss-cloud: run the same eight case ids and classify every local-to-cloud delta
stage_maturity_expectations.tessl-dry-run: stage the same eight case ids without paid external execution
stage_maturity_expectations.tessl-external: run the same OSS-proven eight case ids as external confirmation

improve-agent-native-release-8.identity_rule: Every downstream lane must use exactly the same scenario ids; additions, removals, or substitutions return the candidate to oss-local.
